title: Scrubbable Staggered Animation with CSS @function
partialText: Here's a brand new approach to creating staggered animations in CSS using a single progress value, allowing for smooth linkage to various inputs like scrolling. By utilizing a mathematical formula, it enhances control over animated elements without isolating their timelines, making animations more versatile and scrubbable.
